source_of_positive_vector: Real live production receipt, agent=stillos-foreseal-preflight-check, pulled directly from state/proof-notary/receipts.jsonl (tail -1) on 2026-09-08. Not a synthetic fixture.
note_on_compound_failures: Several negative vectors trip more than one check because the fields are cryptographically bound together by design (e.g. notary_fp and prev_hash are both part of the hashed core preimage, so mutating either one also breaks hash_intact). Each vector's 'reason' below names the PRIMARY thing it tests; 'all_checks_observed' records the complete, real output so nothing is hidden.

vectors.reason: Genuine, unmodified production receipt. Every check must pass.
Core field (ts) mutated by 1 second, receipt_hash left as the ORIGINAL stated value. Recomputed hash no longer matches the stated hash.

The stated receipt_hash itself has one hex character flipped; core fields untouched. Recompute no longer matches the (tampered) stated hash, AND the signature (computed over the original hash string) no longer verifies against the tampered string either.
One base64 character of the signature flipped. Hash recomputation is unaffected (isolates the signature check specifically) but the Ed25519 signature no longer verifies.

A forged-attribution attempt: the receipt_hash was genuinely signed, but by a freshly-generated, unrelated Ed25519 keypair -- while notary_fp still claims the REAL active fingerprint. Isolates the case where a signature is cryptographically valid over SOME key but not the key the receipt claims to be signed by.

prev_hash altered by one character. Because prev_hash is part of the hashed core preimage (not a separate soft-linked pointer), a tampered chain link is caught by hash_intact directly -- the chain is cryptographically bound into the digest itself, not just checked as a side condition.

notary_fp set to a fingerprint absent from BOTH the active and retired keyring entries -- simulates an unrecognized/future signing key or a foreign schema version. Must fail CLOSED (never treat an unknown key as trusted-by-default). Also fails hash_intact since notary_fp is itself part of the hashed core.

conformance_rule: A verifier that reports all_pass:true on ANY negative vector, OR all_pass:false on the positive vector, fails conformance. All 7 vectors above were executed against notary-x402-reference-kit/verify-offline-pinned.js on 2026-09-08 with zero network calls (network_calls_made:0 on every run) and produced exactly the expected/observed results shown -- this is a real run, not an assumed table.
